anya: Heads-up: CRM batch import left ~1.9k rows with owner=null and health_score=NULL. Many have onboarding_status=imported and zero touchpoints. We should avoid alert storms.
ben: Ugh. Quick breakdown: ~1,700 are <$200 MRR, ~150 between $200-500, ~75 >$500. My suggestion: 1) tag all records with source=import_apr23 2) run auto-enrichment for low MRR 3) surface >$500 to the manual claims queue.
rachel: Agreed. Also let's add suppression checks for do_not_contact / gdpr_opt_out and exclude any record with customer_state in (churned, archived).
anya: What about health scoring? We need a deterministic fallback for nulls so downstream dashboards don't flip. Idea: set a transient health_score_temp=20 for nulls, then run recompute after enrichment.
ben: That works. Playbook sketch (pseudo):

- filter: owner is null AND onboarding_status == "imported"
- add_tag: source=import_apr23
- if mrr > 500 -> create task -> queue: cs_claims_high_mrr
- else -> call enrichment-service (writeback=true)
- wait for enrichment complete -> run health_score_recompute
- set health_score_temp for any remaining nulls
- notify #customer-success with summary csv

cs_bot: Playbook draft created: import-apr23-orphan-remediate (sandbox). Preview: 1,920 candidates, sample CSV ready. Use `/playbook preview <id>` to inspect.
ops_lead: Please do not kick off manual claim tasks yet. Run enrichment dry-run tonight; schedule manual claims for Monday to give CS time to triage.
anya: I'll own triage for MRR>500. Ben, can you export CSV with columns: id,mrr,region,created_at,last_activity? Post to shared drive and link here.
ben: Uploaded sample 100 rows to drive: https://drive.redwood.example/s/cs/orphan-remediate-sample.csv. Also attached quick histogram: https://img.redwood.example/hist.png
rachel: One more request: add an audit tag `remediation_run:2026-04-12` and include a run_id in the notification so we can reverse if needed.
cs_bot: Scheduled nightly job import-apr23-orphan-remediate @ 03:30 UTC. Estimated runtime 10m. Logs will post to #customer-success and attach full CSV.
anya: Thanks. We'll monitor for any spikes in alerting and postpone if needed. :thumbsup:
